metadata.case_name: LAI KIN WAH v. HIP HING CONSTRUCTION CO. LTD. AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: sedentary occupation such as a watchman or information officer

injuries.description: disc protrusions of L2-3 and L4-5 with prolapsed disc material impinging on nerve roots (slipped discs, especially at L4-5)
source: Dr Lee called for an MRI scan and from that scan was able to diagnose with certainty that Plaintiff had disc protrusions of L2-3 and L4-5 and that prolapsed disc material was impinging on the nerve roots.
There is no doubt he is suffering from the condition of slipped discs, especially at L4-5 level, there is evidence that the left side nerve roots were impinged by the prolapsed disc material.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of nerve root of lumbar spine

injuries.description: mild lumbar scoliosis convexed to the right with some spasm of the sacro spinalis muscle
source: When the Plaintiff stood, Dr Lee was able to note that he had a mild lumbar scoliosis convexed to the right with some spasm of the sacro spinalis muscle.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

manifestations.description: could not cock up the left great toe and the left forefoot; left extensor hallucis longus and dorsiflexors of ankle are very weak
walked very slowly and deliberately; difficulty getting up on the examination couch; difficulty lying flat on his back
must take painkillers on a regular basis; analgesics have caused stomach ache and constipation
periodic exacerbation of condition which may force him to bed for periods of time

treatments_future: possible spinal fusion operation (considered in 1991 but not performed and problematical now)

losses.description: He has slipped discs with the disc material impinging on his nerve roots. He has chronic lower back pain, sciatica, weakness in one leg and his lumbar movements are materially restricted.

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: He can no longer enjoy outdoor activities such as swimming or basketball.

He is unable to be as active as a father and husband as he has been before the injury; he used to like to take the family out at weekends but, because of his pain, he no longer has the desire to do so.

losses.category: Loss of sexual function and sexual life
losses.description: His sexual relations with his wife have suffered.
His general mobility is materially reduced and he must expect periodic exacerbation of his condition which may even force him to bed for periods of time.
